note: NGPC recreation area at the Gibbon I-80 interchange (Exit 285), built around six small ponds. The RV sites are paved finger loops north of the park road; the ponds and swim beach lie south of it. Primitive tent camping besides. --Claude
summary: RA confirms 33 reservable paved electric sites (17 x 30 A, 16 x 50 A), 19 pull-through, up to 80 ft, showers/laundry/dump, year-round camping (modern facilities May-mid Oct), 180-day window. Fees re-based 10-15 -> 20-30 (RV campground all electric; basic = primitive tent). Pin 260 m south of the site centre (move). Waterfront pond -> not waterfront lead: every pond under 2 acres near the sites and all across the park road.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (stored 'pond' -> not waterfront): RA: '14 acres in 6 ponds'. Flood-fill on Esri imagery: the two ponds nearest the RV loops are about 1.0 acre (40.7064,-98.8399) and 1.8 acres (40.7064,-98.8364), both SOUTH of the main park road, which separates every RV site from them (sites 001 and 020-021 are the closest, ~40-60 m across the road); the other ponds are 0.2, 1.8 and 1.9 acres west and south-west, and the one larger water (~7.5+ acres, 40.7036,-98.8445) is 300 m+ away beyond the day-use area. All are ponds under the ~5-acre line and none fronts a site across open ground: not waterfront (there is no pond-view).
PIN: stored 40.7065,-98.8415 is in the day-use area by the south ponds, 260 m from the RV sites' centre (RA GIS, 33 sites) at 40.70797,-98.83910; move it there.

Fee base re-based to the electric rate on the page's own description (improved electric campground + primitive tent camping) and the NGPC grid; no RA night could be quoted (window ends May 3, 2027), so the $25/$30 are the grid's, not a quote. If AWH knows of non-electric RV pads at Windmill, the base would be the $15/$10 basic rate.
Site count left at the stored 89 (note prose: 69 electric + ~20 basic); RA lists only the 33 reservable sites, and imagery shows more pads in the finger loops, so neither confirmed nor contradicted.
